 Save Time

 Time is of the essence. Take it back by creating professional-grade sports graphics in just minutes — no design experience required! 

 Perfect for Any Sport

 Create graphics for every sport under the sun. Just replace the default photos, update text, and you’re off! 

 For Programs of All Levels

 Get that professional look no matter what level amateur sports program you’re have. From Division I colleges to youth sports leagues, they all use Gipper! 

 FAQ

 What is a rankings graphic? 

 Rankings (or standings) graphics show and highlight how your athletes or team compare to others in your competitive space. These standings graphics are great for promoting the successes your team or athletes are achieving. 

 How do you make rankings graphics? 

 With Gipper, you can create awesome ranking or standings graphics in minutes. Just pick a template, modify the elements you want, and then export. You can also directly post the graphic to your preferred social media channels from within Gipper. It's that easy! 

 Why are rankings graphics useful? 

 Rankings graphics are useful for keeping fans informed on how your team or athletes are doing and marketing your program as a leader compared to the competition. 

 What should my rankings graphics contain? 

 Rankings graphics should contain what place your athlete or team are in compared to others within your league or conference. Gipper makes it easy to update lineups and send out graphics to fans quickly from anywhere, on any device, via the mobile app.
